name: @origingame/engine
description: Origin Engine: the TypeScript API, generated from crates/og-api/api.ogt, and its runtime on the web (wasm in a Worker) and native (napi addon) hosts.

scripts.typecheck: bun x --package typescript@7.0.2 tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json & p=$!; bun x --package typescript@7.0.2 tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.runtime.json; r=$?; wait $p && [ $r -eq 0 ] && bun x --package typescript@7.0.2 tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.templates.json
scripts.test: bun run typecheck && sh scripts/build.sh && bun test --parallel tests/
scripts.test:browser: bun tests/web/wire.ts && bun tests/web/player.ts && bun tests/web/export.ts && bun tests/web/device.ts
